title: Enhanced Diagnostics Partitioning & Device Crash Synchronization
releaseNotes: Partitioned Diagnostics: Render exceptions and runtime errors are partitioned to ensure seamless background crash recovery.
Anonymous Device Diagnostics: Error reports include an anonymous device token to pinpoint hardware-specific regressions with zero personal data collected.
Reconnection Crash Sync: Unsent offline logs now synchronize smoothly upon internet reconnection.
